priorities.name: priority:P0
priorities.description: Production down or data loss; set by a maintainer only

priorities.name: priority:P1
priorities.description: Severe; blocks a team or a release

status.name: ai:ready
status.description: Maintainer-approved; the Director plans it next

status.name: ai:replan
status.description: Send back to the Director for a new plan

status.name: ai:planned
status.description: Plan and classification written; the Developer may start

status.name: ai:pr-ready
status.description: Draft PR opened; waiting for the Quality Gate

status.name: ai:reviewing
status.description: The Quality Gate is reviewing the PR

status.name: ai:changes-required
status.description: The Quality Gate asked for changes

status.name: ai:fixing
status.description: The Developer is addressing Quality Gate findings

status.name: ai:human-approval
status.description: Quality Gate passed; a human reviews and merges

status.name: ai:blocked
status.description: Stopped; a human decides. Never removed by the pipeline when set by a human

changeLevel.name: ai:semver-major
changeLevel.description: Breaking change; never implemented by AI

impact.name: ai:impact-low
impact.description: No auth, migration, contract, core-process or companion-contract change

impact.name: ai:impact-high
impact.description: Touches auth, migration, contract, a core process or a companion contract

risk.name: ai:risk-high
risk.description: Derived: high impact; council when a trigger fires

risk.name: ai:risk-critical
risk.description: Derived: major; never implemented by AI

council.name: ai:council-required
council.description: Run the Architecture Council before development

council.name: ai:council-approved
council.description: Council verdict APPROVED; development authorized, not merge

e2e.name: e2e
e2e.description: Run PR E2E: the suites on an `E2E suites:` line, else the full set

e2e.name: e2e:full
e2e.description: Run PR E2E with the full vnext-example core set
